Money Flow FAQ

No. Money Flow has no sign-up, login, or account system. You can start using it immediately after installing it.

No. Your financial data is stored locally on your device in a SQLite database and is not transmitted to any server, because no such server exists for this app. The app does include a crash-reporting SDK (Firebase Crashlytics) that is currently inactive — see the Privacy Policy's "Crash and Error Reporting" section for details.

You can create a local JSON backup from within the app's settings. This does not require a cloud account; the backup file is saved through your device's document picker or share sheet.

You can restore from a previously created local backup file within the app's settings. This action requires PIN or biometric re-authentication if you have app-lock enabled.

Biometric unlock is optional and used only for the app-lock feature. Biometric matching is handled entirely by your device's operating system; Money Flow does not access or store your biometric data.

The app includes the Google Mobile Ads SDK, but it is currently configured with test ad unit IDs only. Money Flow is not showing live ads at this time.

You can reset all locally stored data from within the app's settings. This permanently removes your accounts, transactions, categories, budgets, goals, investments, and loans from your device.

No. Money Flow is offline-first and its core features, tracking accounts, transactions, budgets, goals, investments, and loans, work without an internet connection.
